Class ShopController

java.lang.Object
com.dami.tcg.controller.ShopController
@Controller public class ShopController extends Object
This controller manages all shop-related actions, including pack opening,card purchases, coin bundle purchases, and displaying shop content. It also interacts with the PlayerDAO and CardDAO to update player data and retrieve available shop cards.
Author:
Brayan, Adam, Oihan and Asier

  • Method Details

    • showPacks

      @GetMapping("/pack") public String showPacks(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session, org.springframework.ui.Model model)
      This method is used to show the pack opening screen, it also checks if there is a player logged and if there's no player logged it returns the user to the login screen. Finally, it sets the price of the pack if the player has the free pack.
      Parameters:
      session - is used to get the logged player's information.
      model - is used to add attributes to the html code like the price of the pack. author Brayan
      Returns:
      if the player is not logged returns to the login screen and if it's logged it redirects to the pack screen.

    • getPackPrice

      @GetMapping("/pack/price") @ResponseBody public Map<String,Object> getPackPrice(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session)
      This method checks if the logged player has the free pack available and changes the packs price on real time.
      Parameters:
      session - is used to get the information of the logged player
      Returns:
      returns a map with the price.

    • openPack

      @PostMapping("/pack") public String openPack(org.springframework.ui.Model model, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session, org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.support.RedirectAttributes redirectAttributes)
      This method is called when clicking the the open pack button and it generates 5 random cards with set chances depending the cards rarity.
      Parameters:
      model - is used to add parameters to the html.
      session - is used to get the logged player's information.
      redirectAttributes - is used add and show error messages. author Adam
      Returns:
      if the player isn't logged it redirects to the loging page and if the player is logged it sends the user to the pack opening screen.

    • showShop

      @GetMapping("/shop") public String showShop(org.springframework.ui.Model model, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session)
      This method shows the webs shop screen it also gets the cards that each player has in the shop, the current time and if the players have the free pack available and it sends them to the html to show them.
      Parameters:
      model - sends if the player has the free pack available, the cards to the html.
      session - gets the information of the logged player. author Oihan
      Returns:
      it sends the users to the shop.

    • buyCards

      @PostMapping(value="/shopCards", params="action=buy-card") public String buyCards(@RequestParam int cardId, org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.support.RedirectAttributes redirectAttributes, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session)
      This method checks if there's a player logged and if theres's any when clicking at each cards button it adds the card to the player and disables that button.
      Parameters:
      cardId - is the Id of the card the user has selected.
      redirectAttributes - is used add and show error messages.
      session - gets the information of the logged player. author Asier
      Returns:
      if there's no player logged it sends to the login section and if there's a logged player it stays at the shop.

    • buyCoins

      @PostMapping(value="/shop", params="action=buy") public String buyCoins(@RequestParam int price, @RequestParam int coins, org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.support.RedirectAttributes redirectAttributes, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session)
      This method checks if there's a player logged and if there's any when clicking at the bundle it sends the player to the a screen to confirm the purchase of coins.
      Parameters:
      price - is the price of the coin bundle selected.
      coins - is the amount of coins for the bundle selected.
      redirectAttributes - is used to send the price and the amount of gold of the bundle selected as attributes when redirecting to the confirmPurchase screen.
      session - gets the information of the logged player. author Brayan
      Returns:
      it sends the user to the screen to confirm the coins purchase.

    • paymentPage

      @GetMapping("/confirmPurchase") public String paymentPage(@RequestParam int price, @RequestParam int coins, org.springframework.ui.Model model, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session)
      This method shows a new window to confirm the purchase of coins.
      Parameters:
      price - is the price of the coin bundle
      coins - is the amount of coins that the bundle selected has.
      model - sends the price of the bundle and the amount of coins to the html.
      session - gets the information of the logged player. author Adam
      Returns:
      if theres no logged player it sends the user to the login page and if there's any it shows the confirm purchase page.

    • buyCoins

      @PostMapping("/confirmPurchase") public String buyCoins(@RequestParam int coins, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session)
      This method adds coins to the player logged and sends the user back to the shop.
      Parameters:
      coins - is the amount of coins that the bundle selected has.
      session - updates the coin amount to the logged player. author Adam
